label: reconstructed from public reports
source: FATF and Egmont Group (2020), Trade-Based Money Laundering: Trends and Developments, FATF, Paris. https://www.fatf-gafi.org/en/publications/Methodsandtrends/Trade-based-money-laundering-trends-and-developments.html
what_happened: Drug proceeds were layered through Australian accounts and used to buy small portable electronics that were exported to South East Asia and the Middle East at undervalued prices.
reconstruction: 4 smartphone export invoices priced at about 0.2x the reference median.
